source: Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries of Preah Vihear Province (មន្ទីរកសិកម្ម រុក្ខាប្រមាញ់ និងនេសាទ ខេត្តព្រះវិហារ), presentation "ដំណើរការផលិតកម្មគ្រាប់ពូជស្រូវសុទ្ធ" (Process of Pure Rice Seed Production), presented by Ms. Yem Sokey (យឹម សុគី), Deputy Head of the Office of Agricultural Techniques and Agricultural Productivity, dated 20 November 2017. Contact: ysophy168@gmail.com, 012 558 312.
text:
Transplanting for pure seed production: seedlings should generally be transplanted at 20-25 days of age; for directly-planted/broadcast rice of medium and late-maturing varieties, growth to about 30-35 days is used. Transplant 2-3 seedlings per hill, arranged in an alternating pattern so hills are not planted too densely. Avoiding overly dense planting helps prevent overcrowding, which if allowed to occur increases pest and disease pressure and hinders even, healthy crop growth.

Water management: proper water management is very important for producing pure seed. After transplanting, water should be kept shallow at first; if the water level becomes too deep too soon it can cause young seedlings to die. Conversely, if water is scarce or fields become too shallow/dry during hot weather, this favors weed growth, which can then act as an opportunistic pest problem, making it difficult for the rice crop to grow well and compete.
